description: Sample customer support tickets for demo. Based on Kaggle Customer Support Ticket Dataset format (CC0 license).

tickets.ticket_description: I was charged twice for my subscription last month. My card shows $29.99 on Dec 1 and Dec 15. Can you help?
tickets.expected_workflow: Quick resolution with refund and goodwill credit

tickets.ticket_description: Our API integration has been failing intermittently for the past 3 days. Error: 'Connection timeout after 30000ms'. This is blocking our production deployment. We need this fixed ASAP.
It would be really helpful if we could export reports in PDF format instead of just CSV. Our finance team needs this for their monthly reviews.
tickets.expected_workflow: Acknowledge, provide workaround, log feature request

tickets.ticket_description: I've been trying to login for the past hour but keep getting 'Invalid credentials' error. I know my password is correct because I just reset it yesterday. This is really frustrating!
Hi, I'm interested in your product. Can you tell me more about pricing for a team of 50 people?

This is absolutely unacceptable! I've been waiting 3 days for a response to my previous ticket about duplicate charges. I've been a customer for 2 years and this is how you treat me? I want to speak to a manager immediately!
We received invoice #INV-2024-1234 but the usage charges seem higher than expected. Can you break down the API call charges? We're seeing $450 in overage fees.

The analytics dashboard has been showing a spinning wheel for the past 20 minutes. I've tried refreshing and clearing cache but nothing works. We have a board meeting in 2 hours and need these reports!

tickets.ticket_subject: Wrong charge amount and multiple questions
tickets.ticket_description: hi, so i just checked my bank and you guys charged me $49.99?? im on the basic plan which is supposed to be $29.99. whats going on? also i need a receipt for this for my taxes. and honestly if this keeps happening im probably gonna cancel, do i lose all my stuff if i do that?
tickets.expected_workflow: Address overcharge, provide receipt, explain cancellation policy
